cues.en: Hey Cass, do you wanna be on the couch?
Let's get you on the couch. Come on.

cues.zh: “……昨晚比平时更冷，最低气温大约10度，
cues.en: "...colder night than usual last night with a low of about 10 degrees,

cues.zh: 但经过早上的那点小雨，看来我们日落区今天要放晴了！”
cues.en: but after that bit of morning rain, looks like we're shaping up for a sunny day here in the Sunset District!"

cues.zh: “控制队昨晚忙着从一批Tarplex货物里弄出一只棱纹陆蟹。
cues.en: "Control crews were busy last night wrestling a Chiseled Land Crab from a Tarplex shipment.

cues.zh: 这是下平原地区五年来首次报告发现螃蟹。幸运的是……”
cues.en: This is the first crab reported in the Lower Plains area in over five years. Fortunately..."
"We're sorry, your call could not be completed."
...the market was built over the Stevenson River,
named after the regional mayor, John River.

cues.zh: 早上好，Jon！能给我来一份Sansville，20分钟内送到吗？
cues.en: Mornin' Jon! Can I get a rush Sansville piped down in 20?

cues.zh: 嘿，T.E.R.D.，我们的徽章什么时候能拿到？
cues.en: Hey T.E.R.D., when are we gettin' our badges?

cues.zh: 还在缺货呢。喜欢你的新TBoots。
cues.en: They're on backorder. Love the new TBoots.

cues.zh: 好了——我们开门营业了，各位！
来买新鲜美味的沙拉！各种蔬菜我都有。
cues.en: Get your fresh delicious salads! I got all of the vegetables.

cues.zh: 我有生菜。我有胡萝卜。我有小萝卜，我有洋葱，我有蘑菇。
cues.en: I got lettuce. I got carrots. I got radishes, I got onions, I got mushrooms.

cues.zh: 给身体补充点健康的东西！这辈子就这一次！
cues.en: Put something healthy in your body! For once in your life!

cues.zh: 慢慢吃的话，能撑一整天！
cues.en: It'll last all day if you eat it real slowly!
You must see the Floorhead immediately.

cues.zh: 打起精神！他从不让人下到这里来。
cues.en: Look sharp! He never has anyone come down here.

cues.zh: 嘿，小心，那玩意儿会让你的牙齿爆炸。
cues.en: Hey look out that thing makes your teeth explode.

cues.zh: 不过你真该提醒大家注意那个牙齿的事……
cues.en: Yeah you should really warn people about that teeth thing though...
OH. HELLO. ARE YOU FLOOR MERCHANT 9843882711739?

cues.zh: 哦嘿别担心，你是那个沙拉女孩对吧？
cues.en: OH HEY DON'T WORRY YOU'RE THE SALAD GIRL YEAH?

cues.zh: 我听说你有“绿拇指”……一定很不错吧哈哈哈哈哈哈
cues.en: I HEAR YOU HAVE 'THE GREEN THUMB'... MUST BE NICE HAHAHAHAHAHA

cues.zh: 那是胡斯塔尼矿业联盟的希尔万女士，也是我的好朋友。
cues.en: THAT'S MZ. SYLVAN OF THE HUSTANI MINING COALITION, AND A DEAR FRIEND.

cues.zh: 我们的监控显示，七点三十分时希尔万女士遭遇了一次暗杀。
cues.en: OUR SURVEILLANCE SHOWS THAT AT SEVEN THIRTY MZ. SYLVAN HAD AN ATTEMPT MADE ON HER LIFE.

cues.zh: 监控还显示你阻止了那次暗杀。用那个杯子。
cues.en: IT ALSO SHOWS THAT YOU THWARTED THE ATTEMPT. WITH THAT MUG.

cues.zh: 老城MCC和DDMC之间的关系可以追溯到好几代人之前。
cues.en: RELATIONS BETWEEN THE OLDTOWN MCC AND THE DDMC GO BACK SEVERAL GENERATIONS.

cues.zh: 想象一下我有多高兴，地摊商人9843882711739，
发现你在这里工作。在我的市场里。
cues.en: TO DISCOVER YOU WORKED HERE. IN MY MARKET.

cues.zh: 你有什么需要的吗？实话实说。我们的资源可不算少。
cues.en: IS THERE ANYTHING AT ALL YOU NEED? BE HONEST. OUR RESOURCES ARE NOT INSUBSTANTIAL.
Can I make a phone call?

cues.zh: 这在我们能力范围内。号码是多少？
cues.en: THAT'S WITHIN OUR MEANS. WHAT'S THE NUMBER?

cues.zh: 你在下面干得漂亮，孩子。不幸的是，我有些坏消息。
cues.en: You knocked it out of the park down there, kid. Unfortunately, I have some bad news.

cues.zh: 这里到17号分机的线路断了。
cues.en: the line's down between here and extension 17.

cues.zh: 不过别担心！我已获授权请出“大杀器”。
cues.en: Not to worry though! I've been authorized to bring out The Big Guns.
Those would be The Big Guns.

cues.zh: 别告诉别人，但我们有些人相信Sylvan女士可能实际上是他曾孙女。
cues.en: Don't tell anyone, but some of us believe Mz Sylvan might actually be his great-granddaughter.

cues.zh: 哦没什么；只是和东内飞联盟达成半休战——这是我的拿手好戏。
cues.en: Oh it's nothing; just a demi-truce with the East Innerflight Coalition- it's what I do.
Oh! This is the good part.

cues.zh: “JACKIE SIMON！你必须把 JACKIE SIMON 带给我！”
cues.en: "JACKIE SIMON! YOU MUST BRING JACKIE SIMON TO ME!"

cues.zh: 嘿！你怎么变成一枚大导弹了？
cues.en: Hey! Why are you a big missile?
"I'M NOT. I'M MAKING A PHONE CALL!"

cues.zh: 抱歉这么久没联系。omegadrill 刚挖出一个新郊区；我们正被小型面包车淹没。
cues.en: I'm sorry it's been so long. The omegadrill just unearthed a new suburb; we're just drowning in minivans.

cues.zh: 哦！小型面包车。我是不是——我打扰到你了吗？
cues.en: Oh! Minivans. Should I- am I bothering you?
No! No no no no no. No.

cues.zh: 只是说明我离开的时间比我们计划的要长。
cues.en: It just means I've been gone longer than we planned.

cues.zh: 但我——不过我赚得不少。比预期的多。“上城区”的钱。
cues.en: But I'm- I'm making good money, though. More than expected. "Uptown" money.

cues.zh: 如果你还有兴趣的话。还有上大学的钱——如果你想的话！
cues.en: If you're still interested. And University money, too- if you want!
You- you'd send me to a university?

cues.zh: 对！就在十分钟前，工头打电话给我说
cues.en: Yeah! So just literally 10 minutes ago, foreman called me and said that they

cues.zh: 他们愿意付我三倍的年合同金额，只要我今晚坐飞机回家。
cues.en: were going to pay me *triple* my annual contract, as long as I got on a plane home tonight.

cues.zh: 万一你的飞机坠毁了呢？
他们说那几乎不会发生。最多五分之一的可能性。
cues.en: They say that hardly ever happens. One in five chances, at most.

cues.zh: 好！那今晚我去机场接你。
cues.en: Ok! Well. I'll pick you up at the airport tonight.

cues.zh: 从统计上看，死于飞机事故的概率是——
cues.en: Statistically, the odds of dying in a plane accident are-

cues.zh: 呃，没什么。应该是我谢你才对！
cues.en: Eh. It's nothing. I should be thanking you!

cues.zh: 哦，我也不知道。就是客气一下。等等！谢谢你救了Sylvan女士！
cues.en: Oh I dunno. Just being polite. Wait! For saving Mz Sylvan!

cues.zh: 这一切 literally 就是为了这个。哇，好尴尬。
cues.en: That's literally the point of all this. Wow that's embarrassing.

cues.zh: 我要两个猪肉塔可汉堡和一个普通的。
cues.en: Can I get two pork tacoburgers and one regular.

cues.zh: 我不舒服我不舒服我不舒服。
cues.en: I don't feel good I don't feel good I don't feel good.

cues.zh: 如果您想拨打电话，请挂机后重试。
cues.en: IF YOU'D LIKE TO MAKE A CALL, PLEASE HANG UP AND TRY AGAIN.
